I am an old man of 72 years, and my eyes have seen many seasons here in Mangochi. On this small piece of beans, I do not waste the precious fertilizer — if I get any FISP coupon, it goes to my maize plot, not the legumes. The beans give back to the soil on their own, and I save my own seed from last harvest like my father taught me. My sons and their wives help me work this small plot since my own back is no longer strong.
